task.description: DOC-UPDATER (WF-02 Step 6) for REQ-159, which passed RELEASE-VALIDATOR (Step 5, PASS -- see step-05-release-validator.json). (1) Flip REQ-159's status in docs/requirements.yaml from 'pending' to 'done'. (2) Append a 'done' event for REQ-159 to the current run-history volume -- check docs/status/requirement_status.index.yaml for the current volume, recount `grep -c "^  - req:" <current volume path>` before and after appending, update the index's note with the new count per its own established convention. The done event's note should mention: the requirement's substance (first requirement to implement real platform.* host-function bodies -- read_variable, get_instance_state, log; new Letflow.Engine.LuaNumberMarshalling per REQ-150); that Step 1b CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR found and required fixing a real design-stage authorization gap (get_instance_state originally, via an unsupported invented scenario, allowed reading ANY instance the tenant owned -- fixed to restrict to a script's own instance only, :forbidden uniformly for anything else); that TEST-DESIGNER separately found and closed a real mutation-detectable test gap (tests verified the CORRECT RETURN VALUE of the self-instance check but not the actual security property -- that no Repo/database call happens at all on a mismatch -- closed with a :telemetry.attach/4-based test, independently re-verified by TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR and spot-checked again by RELEASE-VALIDATOR at the source level); that SECURITY-REVIEWER additionally confirmed no timing side-channel exists between a same-tenant-sibling-instance rejection and a nonexistent-instance rejection; and that ELIXIR-DEV made two well-justified implementation deviations from the design's literal text (run_stub arity, log's explicit Lua.decode!/2 step) which REVIEWER confirmed were forced by the real tv-labs/lua library API and which TEST-DESIGNER documented via a design-doc addendum. (3) README.md: check for staleness (likely none, per this session's precedent). (4) Confirm no docs/migration/stage-N-*.md or decisions/ file was named in REQ-159's acceptance_criteria requiring an update.
